nodes.description: DashSports public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances for the custom token.
DashSports public nested mapping allowance(owner=>spender=>uint) used by transferFrom.
Private owner address set in the constructor; gate for privileged functions.
tradeAddress used inside ensure() as a whitelisted sender that skips sale conditions.
canSale mapping that whitelists addresses in ensure(), set to true by _mints.
_onSaleNum mapping counting transfers per sender for sale-limit enforcement.
_minSale minimum sale amount used by condition().
_maxSale maximum sale amount used by condition().
_saleNum maximum number of transfers per address enforced by condition().
DashSports public totalSupply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals = 18 used in supply scaling arithmetic.
Constant UNI router address 0x7a250d...488D hardcoded in DashSports.
ERC20 private _balances mapping backing the reference implementation.
ERC20 private _allowances nested mapping.
ERC20 private _totalSupply updated by _mint/_burn.
DashSports.transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
DashSports.transferFrom(address,uint,uint) payable; moves balances with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
DashSports.ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist bypass for owner/tradeAddress/UNI/canSale senders.
DashSports.condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces sale count, min and max sale limits.
DashSports.delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall (privilege escalation).
DashSports._mints(address,uint) public; mints balances for owner or a hardcoded address and sets canSale.
DashSports.init(uint,uint,uint) sets _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale, owner only.
DashSports.batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-only mass transfer with unchecked multiplication.
DashSports.setTradeAddress(address) owner only; updates the whitelisted trade address.
DashSports.approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance for msg.sender.
DashSports.pairFor internal pure; computes the Uniswap-V2 pair address from factory and token hashes.
DashSports constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and infinite allowance to the UNI router.
ERC20._transfer internal; SafeMath guarded balance movement.
ERC20._approve internal; SafeMath free allowance write with zero-address checks.
ERC20.transferFrom public; calls _transfer and _approve with SafeMath-subtracted allowance.
ERC20._mint internal; increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
ERC20._burn internal; decreases balance and _totalSupply.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn private; performs arbitrary low-level call to an external token contract.
Context._msgSender internal view returns payable msg.sender.
Address.isContract internal view using extcodehash to detect contracts.
SafeMath.add/sub with overflow and underflow requires.
SafeMath.mul with overflow require.
msg.sender used in DashSports transfer/transferFrom/approve as the acting account.
msg.sender used as the authorisation check in DashSports._mints.
msg.sender used as the owner check in DashSports.delegate.
msg.sender used as owner check across init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Arbitrary delegatecall of attacker-supplied address and calldata inside delegate().
External low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn enabling token-controlled reentrancy.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath in transferFrom.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in _mints.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the _from argument of transfer(), so the caller controls the source account.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and _onSaleNum, controlling the spender authorisation path.
approve stores an allowance keyed by msg.sender as owner.
_mints minting rights are decided by comparing msg.sender to owner or a hardcoded address.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass-minting balances.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before updating the whitelisted trade address.
transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure requires condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the paired token address through pairFor().
transferFrom's policy enforcement can be bypassed through the ensure whitelist.
ensure returns true early for owner, tradeAddress, UNI pair or canSale senders, skipping sale limits.
delegate hands control to an arbitrary address via delegatecall with arbitrary calldata.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call that can re-enter the caller.
callOptionalReturn requires the token address to be a contract via isContract().
_msgSender returns the raw msg.sender account.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
_mints computes addedValue * 10**decimals without overflow protection.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] with a plain unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction and addition mutate the balanceOf mapping.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed without SafeMath.
User supplied _value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
_mints writes an unchecked, arbitrarily large balance into balanceOf[spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting the address in ensure().
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of transfers per address.
init sets _minSale using unchecked scaling arithmetic.
init sets _maxSale using unchecked scaling arithmetic.
init sets _saleNum directly from a caller parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
ensure reads tradeAddress and returns true for that sender.
DashSports constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial owner.
Constructor sets totalSupply and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
ERC20._transfer subtracts and adds entries in _balances under SafeMath.
ERC20._approve overwrites the _allowances entry.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer for the balance movement.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to spend the allowance.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
_mint adds to the recipient entry of _balances.
_burn subtracts from the account entry of _balances.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add and SafeMath.sub for all balance arithmetic.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance arithmetic.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for supply and balance arithmetic.
SafeERC20 and ERC20 import SafeMath.mul for scaled amount arithmetic.
_to parameter is the recipient forwarded to transferFrom.
_value parameter is the amount forwarded to transferFrom.
_from parameter supplies the source balance slot in transferFrom.
_to parameter supplies the destination balance slot in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance decrement and the ensure policy check.
_from parameter selects the whitelist branch inside ensure().
_to parameter is compared against owner and UNI pairs inside ensure().
_value parameter is passed to condition() for sale-limit checks.
Target address a of the delegatecall is fully attacker-controlled by the owner.
Calldata b is executed in the DashSports storage context via delegatecall.
spender parameter receives arbitrarily minted balance and canSale rights.
addedValue parameter is scaled by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
token parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals to set _minSale without SafeMath.
_tos parameter supplies every recipient of the batch transfer.
_value parameter participates in the unchecked multiplication for total.
addr parameter becomes the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Local total is the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
Local total flows into the unchecked balance deduction of batchSend.
Local loop index i drives iteration over _tos.
Local _to receives each recipient and is credited balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Local _UNI is the pairFor result compared with _from in ensure().
Return data from the external low-level call is decoded and used to gate execution.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to of transfer is only meaningful as part of transfer's dataflow.
Parameter _value of transfer is only meaningful as part of transfer's dataflow.
Parameter _from is the volatile source slot handled by transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the destination slot handled by transferFrom.
Parameter _value directly drives the unchecked balance and allowance subtraction.
Parameter _from only selects the whitelist branch of ensure.
Parameter _to is only compared against whitelisted addresses in ensure.
Parameter _value is passed through ensure into condition's limit checks.
Parameter a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata payload of the unsafe delegatecall.
Parameter spender is the account whose balance and canSale flag _mints mutates.
Parameter addedValue is the unchecked multiplier in the minted amount.
Parameter token is only used to derive the _minSale state within init.
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient set iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is a factor of the unchecked total multiplication.
Parameter addr is written directly into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Local total is the temporary result of the unchecked multiplication.
Local i is the ephemeral loop counter of batchSend.
Local _to is a transient alias of _tos[i] inside batchSend.
Local _UNI is a transient pair address compared inside ensure.
Local returndata is the raw result of the external low-level call.
